titulo: The remote that could copy every other remote

frases.texto: This remote could copy every other remote in the house.
It came from the man who designed the Apple II.
frases.dicho: It came from the man who designed the Apple Two.

frases.texto: You held your old one up to it, and it watched flashes your eyes can't see.
One button could turn the TV on, start the tape, and find the channel.
It could even do that while you were out.
But you had to program it, and it was as long as a pencil.
Cheaper remotes, from companies people already knew, sold instead.
The next year, he put the company up for sale.
The idea didn't die. It moved into your phone.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still keeps a pile of remotes on the table.
